name: cloudy

description: Publish HTML pages to a stable link, see your spaces and work through the comments people leave.
author: cloudy

commands.name: search-spaces
commands.title: Search Spaces
commands.subtitle: Cloudy

commands.name: publish-html-file
commands.title: Publish HTML File
commands.subtitle: Cloudy
commands.description: Publish an HTML file as a new space, or as a new version of a space you have, and copy its link.

scripts.prepublishOnly:
echo "

It seems like you are trying to publish the Raycast extension to npm.

If you did intend to publish it to npm, remove the \`prepublishOnly\` script and rerun \`npm publish\` again.
If you wanted to publish it to the Raycast Store instead, use \`npm run publish\` instead.

" && exit 1
